changes: Expose bounded machine-readable evidenceReasons on unknown rule metrics without changing rule transition, observation-gap, prediction or clear semantics.
Preserve selected-frame evidence reasons in history and exact analyzed previews.
Filter requested-source events before the 100-event display limit; filter historical store reads by requested source before their limit.
Skip live history samples lacking mediaTimeSeconds during media-time alignment instead of subtracting None.
Avoid copying current tracks, metrics and event lists that a historical snapshot immediately replaces.
Replace per-metric nested rule scans in frame-history capture with a source-rule set; reuse the camera configuration during rule projection.
Remove duplicate deep copies during exact-preview assembly; the locked public DTO traversal still detaches the full metadata tree before serialization, without dropping metadata.

Fix small polygon self-intersection validation by comparing each orientation determinant against EPS instead of comparing their product against EPS. Nonzero-area crossed polygons at normalized scale 0.005 are rejected; valid small polygons and endpoint/collinear intersection behavior are preserved.

contract.format: Sorted unique array of bounded reason codes; empty unless status is unknown. Older stored frames may omit the field.
contract.limits: Reasons identify missing rule evidence, not necessarily a disconnected camera. No reason is inferred from VLM prose, simulator actor state or UI guesses. Multiple actual causes can coexist.
